<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3+"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Silversoul Bomb](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3153)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=528" />
<trait label="Bomb" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=548" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
<trait label="Splash" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=699" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 73

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Two Actions" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This rare alchemical bomb gathers and concentrates the emotions that linger in a burial ground where generations of beloved ancestors have been interred, infusing that powerful emotional energy into the alchemically prepared powdered silver stored within the bomb. This energy glows with a soft, silver radiance and, if contained in a clear container, allows a silversoul bomb to be used as a torch to illuminate an area.

 A silversoul bomb grants an item bonus to attack rolls and deals mental damage plus additional effects, according to the bomb's type. [Nindorus](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=353) are particularly harmed by silversoul bombs and take the listed persistent mental damage, according to the bomb's type. Against nindorus, the bomb's item bonus also applies to its save DC to resist being dazzled or blinded. Creatures that have weakness to silver (including most nindorus) have an equal amount of weakness to the mental damage caused by a silversoul bomb, due to the silver infused into the energy within.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs=""
>
Silversoul Bomb
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 73

**Price** 10 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, and the bomb deals 2d4 mental damage, 1d6 persistent mental damage to nindorus, and 2 mental splash damage. A creature that takes splash damage from the bomb and fails a DC 17 Fortitude save is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round as glowing silver particles cling to its face.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 11"
pfs=""
>
Silversoul Bomb (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 73

**Price** 250 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls, and the bomb deals 3d4 mental damage, 2d6 persistent mental damage to nindorus, and 3 mental splash damage. A creature that takes splash damage from the bomb and fails a DC 28 Fortitude save is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) for 1 round and then dazzled for 1 round thereafter.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 17"
pfs=""
>
Silversoul Bomb (Major)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 73

**Price** 2,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You gain a +3 item bonus to attack rolls, and the bomb deals 4d4 mental damage, 3d6 persistent mental damage to nindorus, and 4 mental splash damage. A creature that takes splash damage from the bomb is dazzled for 1 round unless it fails a DC 37 Fortitude save, in which case it's permanently blinded.
